text: I really felt like magic, like awe. Lost love story, the man falls in love right at the beginning and then loses it, and it goes on and on. The lights, the water, the music, the visual design, all fit together and made things beautiful. Breathtaking moments. On stage we had actors, dancers, swimmers, acrobats, and everything very very precise, flips, dives, breathing holds. Swimmers holding their breath for many seconds, very impressive. Dramatic emotional drama and some pretty funny moments too. Just very moving really, and very imaginative and grand. If you can see it, do, it's a must see.
